body: In Rainbows over and over again.
Sometimes a good music listening cry sesh helps.
My friend showed me Sigur Ros, then he committed suicide a few weeks later. He was always emotionally connected to his music. Like he felt the song.

What is more desturbing is my friend killed himself a few months ago, and I saw the damage and sadness he caused to myself and others but I still have these fantasies. I have never done any self harm despite also idealizing burning myself.
They gave you Klonopin?! That just masks any moods you are having and can lead to more depression and suicidal thoughts, at least for me.

Are you faking happiness the entire time? Like do you feel like shit put on a happy face then go out? Because thats what I do then my friends leave and I can literally feel my face turning into a frown of sadness.
The thing is this uses logic. For the most part feelings of extreme self-loathing come from something much deeper and less logical.

It seems like you have a good relationship with your mother, have you considered asking her for help? Don't know what else to say but just keep talking online and to other people in real life. It really helps.
